headline: ROUND 127 — THE ELECTION IS DECIDED AND THE FORCE IS ENLARGED

events.title: THE ELECTION RESULT IS FORMALLY ANNOUNCED AND VALERIUS IS ELECTED
events.body: The Roman electoral authorities formally announce that Gaius Maximus Valerius has been elected. The development uses established personnel and institutions. Existing directives and ownership arrangements remain unchanged except for the documented soldier intake. No unsupported future revenue or separate military body is created. The relevant records are preserved for later rounds. The event advances an established thread.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Directly caused by an established directive or immediate action.
